messages.author: 2710b717e5dbb066
messages.subject: Re: smooth line
parts:
Look at the function `xspline` (or related functions in grid).  You can give `xspline` your points and the argument `draw=FALSE` and it will return a set of points that you can pass to the ggplot2 functions to get a smooth curve.  The amount of smoothness and how the points influence the curve depends on the parameters that you set.
